subject: Approval request: two runtime/infra hires (senior) — comp bands & budget
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: two runtime/infra hires (senior) — comp bands & budget

Hi Laura / Markus,

I’m requesting approval to open two senior headcount slots on the runtime/infra team (roles attached). Summary:
- Role: Senior Runtime Engineer (backend + kernel optimizations) x2
- Justification: critical to reach Q4 throughput targets (KV cache work + batching infra). Without these hires we won’t meet the SLA commitments for two pilot customers.
- Level & comp: we’re proposing 2x L5 (senior IC) or 1x L6 + 1x L5 if preferred. Proposed bands in attached comp-band-runtime.pdf.
- Budget: estimated fully loaded cost ~ $420k/year per hire at L6, ~$320k/year at L5. See attached hc-cost-estimate.xlsx for breakdown. Hiring start target: onboard by Sep 30.

Attachments: comp-band-runtime.pdf, jr-sr-runtime-jd.pdf

Ask: please approve headcount and the proposed bands (or flag if we need to fit to a tighter budget). If approved, Evelyn will begin offers and I’ll coordinate with recruiting/TA on pipeline.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Staff Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: two runtime/infra hires (senior) — comp bands & budget

Thanks Dylan — this looks reasonable at a high level. Two quick asks before I sign off:
1) Can Finance confirm the FY26 vs FY27 budget impact and whether these are incremental or reallocated? Marcus, can you run the delta and post to the hiring tracker?
2) Can TA confirm candidate pipeline + expected offer acceptance timeline? Evelyn.

Assuming answers are clean I’m inclined to approve 2 headcount but would prefer 1x L6 + 1x L5 if that keeps our cost-per-feature lower while preserving senior coverage. Please reply with the two items above and I’ll escalate to Markus for final exec approval if needed.

- Laura
VP Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: two runtime/infra hires (senior) — comp bands & budget

Laura / Dylan — ran the numbers and attached a conservative TCO. Key points:
- FY26: partial-year cost if onboarded by Sep (pro-rated recruiting + comp) = ~$230k per role (L6) / ~$170k per role (L5).
- FY27: full-year fully loaded = ~$420k (L6) / ~$320k (L5).
- Hiring 1xL6 + 1xL5 reduces FY27 spend by ~ $100k vs 2xL6.

Attachment: hc-cost-estimate.xlsx

Recommendation: approve 1xL6 + 1xL5 and mark as incremental headcount to Q4 hiring plan. We can absorb in the infra budget with minor reallocation from cloud efficiency initiatives.

Marcus
Director, Finance (Infrastructure)
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: two runtime/infra hires (senior) — comp bands & budget

Quick update from TA:
- Pipeline: we have two strong inbound candidates (one referred, one sourced via BrightPath) who map to L5/L6. Priya N. (external) is the stronger fit for L6; recruiter introduction thread below.
- Timeline: interview loop can complete in 2–3 weeks, offer + negotiation 1 week, typical notice 3–6 weeks. Onboard target of Sep 30 is achievable if we start interviews the week of Jul 12.
- Offer docs: I’ll use the attached offer-template-sr-runtime.docx and will align comp to the bands in comp-band-runtime.pdf.

Attachment referenced: offer-template-sr-runtime.docx

Evelyn
Senior Recruiter, People Ops
Redwood Inference

I’m comfortable with Marcus’s finance recommendation: proceed with 1x L6 + 1x L5, mark as incremental Q4 headcount.
